stages.label: PRD Builder
stages.desc: Shaping the product brief before any plan exists.

stages.label: Planning Wizard
stages.desc: The guided interview that turns the brief into goals.

stages.label: Plan Drafting
stages.desc: Writing and revising the plan document.

stages.label: PlanUnit Compilation
stages.desc: Breaking the plan into units of work.

stages.label: WorkNode Generation
stages.desc: Turning units into concrete steps agents can run.

stages.label: Verification Run
stages.desc: Tests and checks that prove a step worked.

stages.label: Gate Evaluation
stages.desc: Deciding whether work may move on to the next step.

stages.label: Audit Review
stages.desc: A second look at finished work for gaps.

stages.label: Certification
stages.desc: Final sign-off that the work is complete.

findings.title: Gate passed without a test result
findings.claim: The gate for PlanUnit F3-441 recorded a pass, but the pre-merge test job never reported a result. The pass may rest on a run that did not happen.

findings.title: Retry loop ignores the provider's wait time
findings.claim: The new request helper retries straight away after a rate-limit reply instead of waiting the time the provider asked for. Under load this gets the account throttled for longer.

findings.title: Verification ran against a cached build
findings.claim: The verification step reused yesterday's build output, so the tests did not cover the six files changed this morning.

findings.title: Two helpers differ only by capital letters
findings.claim: parseConfig and ParseConfig both exist in the settings module. One is probably a leftover, and the pair is easy to mix up.

findings.title: WorkNode 7 repeated the migration step
findings.claim: Two WorkNodes both ran the database migration, which would have applied it twice.
